detail.title: Clamps for fluid conduits
detail.abstract: In the field of air handling, or indeed any type of fluid handling, there is provided clamp, for holding first and second fluid conduits in fluid-tight engagement with one another via respective flanges thereof. The clamp comprises first and second clamp body portions that define corresponding first and second mutually opposed flange engagement formations. The first clamp body portion is slidably received within the second clamp body portion to restrain linearly movement of the first and second flange engagement formations towards and away from one another. The first and second flange engagement formations are resiliently biased towards one another.
